description: Market entry and remediation roadmap. Phase 4 of the advisory engagement (see steering/advisory-engagement.md section 1).
sequencingPrinciples: 1. Red flags first. Non-CSPRNG outcome determination and client-side outcome determination block certification everywhere and require core rework.
2. Architectural differences before feature differences. Data residency, jackpot presence and RTP target change the design; an autoplay flag does not.

3. Strictest market first. Certifying the strictest market forces resolution of the hardest technical and documentation problems, and those results are reusable. Reverse sequencing usually requires substantial rework.
4. Run verification work in parallel with development. Resolving an UNVERIFIED value can take weeks (written regulator enquiry, counsel opinion). Do not schedule it after development.
externalLeadTimeItems: Germany: per-game GGL permission, including supplying a playable build
Brazil: Portuguese-language certification filings via SIGAP, and confirming the certifier's current accreditation standing
Central system integration onboarding (LUGAS, Limitdatei, OASIS, Spelpaus, CRUKS, ROFUS, GAMSTOP, iGO, SAFE/TamperToken)
Curacao: establishing a Curacao entity with a resident managing director
Brazil: establishing a Brazilian entity with a 20% local shareholder and a .bet.br domain
Philippines: separate PAGCOR accreditation for each B2B party

engagement.anchorMarketRationale: Which market is being certified first, and why it is the strictest in scope

tasks.task: Replace any non-cryptographic RNG in outcome determination
Move all outcome determination server-side; remove client derivability
Reconcile production builds against valid certification reports
Close any path allowing self-excluded or under-age players to bet

phases.name: Market scoping and legal status confirmation
phases.gate: Every in-scope market has a confirmed lawful path

tasks.task: Remove prohibited and grey markets from scope, or obtain local counsel opinion
Confirm client role (B2B supplier / operator / platform / self-operated) and the responsibility matrix
Confirm DATA RESIDENCY for every in-scope market
tasks.notes: Architectural. Must be settled before design commitments.

tasks.task: Confirm local entity and shareholding requirements
Select the anchor (strictest) market

phases.name: Verification of MEDIUM and UNVERIFIED values
phases.gate: Every value used in the product specification is HIGH confidence, or is an accepted named risk

tasks.task: Retrieve primary instruments for every product-driving value
Submit written regulator enquiries where public sources are insufficient
Obtain licence condition summaries from operator partners (B2B)
Confirm the current accreditation standing of each intended test laboratory
Deployment topology aligned to data residency requirements
maxStake refactored to a runtime-resolvable interface (age and risk tiering)
Server-side enforced capability flags for autoplay, turbo, multi-game
Session state machine supporting forced breaks (Germany 5-minute wait)
Audit data classified with per-category retention and deletion rules
Central system integrations built fail-closed, with all required checkpoints
Separate maths model where jackpots must be removed and RTP redistributed
Disconnect recovery, multi-stage persistence, wallet idempotency, game recall

phases.name: Mathematics verification and documentation
phases.gate: PAR sheet complete and internally verified

tasks.task: Theoretical RTP by enumeration or closed form, high-precision arithmetic
Determine simulation sample size from target precision and measured sigma
Simulate using production code path and production config
Reconcile theoretical vs simulated within the 95% confidence interval; per-prize reconciliation
Compute RTP for ALL wager configurations including the minimum bet
Compute the probability of winning the maximum prize (Germany disclosure, Brazil 1-in-100-million rule)
Compute effective hit frequency (returns exceeding stake) for celebration rules
Produce the PAR sheet, all 15 sections, bound to the build hash
Produce the seven certification documents

phases.name: Anchor market certification
phases.gate: Certification report obtained for the anchor market

tasks.task: Pre-submission self-check against the submission checklist
Engage the laboratory and book the slot
Source code review support (UK requires RNG implementation review)
Remediate laboratory findings
Regulator filing (e.g. UK Games Register before release)

phases.gate: Each market has its own valid approval

Per-market central system integration testing

Pre-deployment compliance gate operating, hotfixes included
